---
title: "Sales Dashboard"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: [brand, brandkit.scss]
    orientation: rows
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
library(brandkit)

# Sets the ggplot2 theme, the default discrete scales, and the knitr
# device background from _brand.yml. Every plot below inherits the brand
# from this one call — there is no per-plot theming in this document.
brand_quarto_setup()

# --- Sample data — replace with your own ---------------------------------
sales <- data.frame(
  Month   = factor(rep(month.abb, each = 4), levels = month.abb),
  Region  = rep(c("North", "South", "East", "West"), times = 12),
  Revenue = c(
    24, 19, 27, 25, 28, 22, 31, 29, 32, 26, 34, 33, 27, 23, 29, 29,
    36, 30, 38, 36, 39, 34, 42, 40, 37, 32, 40, 39, 42, 37, 45, 41,
    44, 39, 47, 42, 40, 36, 43, 39, 46, 41, 49, 44, 50, 45, 53, 47
  ) * 1000
)
sales$Orders <- round(sales$Revenue / seq(300, 320, length.out = nrow(sales)))
```

# {.sidebar}

```{r}
checkboxGroupInput(
  "regions", "Regions",
  choices  = c("North", "South", "East", "West"),
  selected = c("North", "South", "East", "West")
)

sliderInput(
  "months", "Months",
  min = 1, max = 12, value = c(1, 12), step = 1
)

hr()

helpText(
  "Styling comes from _brand.yml via the ", tags$code("brand"),
  " theme; brandkit.scss layers cards, tables and headings on top."
)
```

# Dashboard

## Row {height="22%"}

<!--
Icon and colour are given as cell options rather than in the `list(icon =,
color =, value =)` form the Quarto docs show for static dashboards. Under
`server: shiny` that list is printed by knitr rather than intercepted, and
Quarto uses the chunk's *output* as the value — so the whole list ends up
rendered inside the box. Passing icon/colour as options leaves the chunk
emitting only the value, which is what the box wants either way.
-->

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Revenue"
#| icon: cash-stack
#| color: primary
textOutput("kpi_revenue")
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Orders"

#| color: secondary
textOutput("kpi_orders")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

filtered <- reactive({
  d <- sales[sales$Region %in% input$regions, ]
  d[as.integer(d$Month) >= input$months[1] &
    as.integer(d$Month) <= input$months[2], ]
})

monthly <- reactive({
  d <- filtered()
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(d[0, ])
  agg <- aggregate(cbind(Revenue, Orders) ~ Month, data = d, FUN = sum)
  agg[order(agg$Month), ]
})

# --- Value boxes ---------------------------------------------------------

output$kpi_revenue <- renderText({
  paste0("$", format(round(sum(filtered()$Revenue) / 1000), big.mark = ","), "K")
})

output$kpi_orders <- renderText({
  format(sum(filtered()$Orders), big.mark = ",")
})

output$kpi_aov <- renderText({
  d <- filtered()
  if (sum(d$Orders) == 0) return("—")
  paste0("$", round(sum(d$Revenue) / sum(d$Orders)))
})

output$kpi_growth <- renderText({
  m <- monthly()
  if (nrow(m) < 2) return("—")
  paste0(round(100 * (m$Revenue[nrow(m)] / m$Revenue[1] - 1)), "%")
})

# --- Plots ---------------------------------------------------------------
# No theming code here: brand_quarto_setup() already set theme_brand() as
# the active ggplot2 theme and the brand palette as the default discrete
# colour and fill scale.

output$revenue_plot <- renderPlot({
  d <- filtered()
  req(nrow(d) > 0)
  ggplot(d, aes(Month, Revenue, fill = Region)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0("$", x / 1000, "K")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Revenue", fill = NULL)
})

output$share_plot <- renderPlot({
  d <- filtered()
  req(nrow(d) > 0)
  share <- aggregate(Revenue ~ Region, data = d, FUN = sum)
  ggplot(share, aes(x = "", y = Revenue, fill = Region)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme(
      axis.text        = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
      # theme_brand() sets panel.grid.major explicitly, so it has to be
      # blanked by name — a blanket panel.grid = element_blank() does not
      # override it. Under coord_polar the gridlines curve into rings.
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
})

output$orders_plot <- renderPlot({
  m <- monthly()
  req(nrow(m) > 0)
  cols <- brand_colors()
  ggplot(m, aes(as.integer(Month), Orders, group = 1)) +
    geom_line(color = cols$primary, linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(color = cols$secondary, size = 3) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(month.abb), labels = month.abb) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Orders")
})

# --- Table ---------------------------------------------------------------

output$detail_table <- renderTable({
  m <- monthly()
  req(nrow(m) > 0)
  data.frame(
    Month   = as.character(m$Month),
    Revenue = paste0("$", format(round(m$Revenue / 1000), big.mark = ","), "K"),
    Orders  = format(m$Orders, big.mark = ",")
  )
}, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE, width = "100%")
```
